data.name: RainTweak
data.subtitle: Discord client mod with themes and QoL fixes
data.localizedDescription: RainTweak injects Rain - the community Discord client mod - into the official Discord iOS app, adding themes, appearance options and quality-of-life fixes on top of a current Discord build. The ready-to-sideload IPA is built and published by the RainTweak project itself, so the download comes straight from the developer's own releases.
data.versionDescription:
Discord 0.9.3 | RainTweak

RainTweak (Rain for Discord iOS) - themes, appearance tweaks and QoL fixes injected into the official Discord iOS app. Published as a ready-to-sideload IPA by the RainTweak project; official IPA comes from the Codeberg releases page with the GitHub mirror as a failover.

compatibility.notes: Official IPA from the RainTweak project's own Codeberg releases (its GitHub mirror is tracked as a failover). Discord 343+ builds require iOS 16 or newer. Shares com.hammerandchisel.discord with any other sideloaded Discord build - install one at a time.
